aiResearchSummary.text: Thatgamecompany, Inc. is focused on enhancing the interactivity of its video games by integrating physical articles into virtual environments. They have developed a system and method for authenticating physical items, like decorative pins, using mobile devices. This technology ensures secure verification of products for use within their games, bridging the gap between tangible merchandise and digital experiences. Their R&D efforts emphasize creating a seamless connection between real-world objects and in-game elements.
